description: Wave 3b — neutral objects WITHOUT the lantern prop. Wave 3 literalized the style descriptor's 'lantern light' into a physical lantern in 100% of neutral images; a fully-correlated prop would leak into the style trigger regardless of captioning. Same subjects, anti-lantern negatives — the warm-light-in-gloom LIGHTING stays, the prop goes. A few wave-3 lantern images are retained at curation (captioned) so 'lantern' stays a captionable concept.
style_prefix: hand-painted oil-and-ink concept art, muted peat-and-tallow palette, soft charcoal outlines, a single warm lantern light in cold fen gloom, grim folkloric, matte painterly texture

defaults.negative: anime, manga, cartoon, cel shading, chibi, cute, photograph, photorealistic, 3d render, smooth CG, human person, creature, monster, animal, modern gear, gun, text, watermark, frame, border, signature, lantern, oil lamp, candle, lamp, torch, light fixture
